'''Commenor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region, home to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moons]] [[Folor]] and [[Brelor]].
